subject: General Intelligence and Reasoning
question:
39 is related to 168 by a certain logic. Following the same logic, 52 is related to 194. To which of the following is 71 related, following the same logic?

(Note: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers without breaking them into their constituent digits. For example, for 13, operations such as adding, subtracting, multiplying, or dividing 13 are allowed. Breaking 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing operations on the individual digits is not allowed.)
explanation:
Logic:

Output = (Number × 3) + 51

  • 39 × 3 + 51 = 168
  • 48 × 3 + 51 = 195
  • 71 × 3 + 51 = 264


If it still doesn't render after this, the issue is with how the explanation is saved in your backend database.

For example, if the backend saved the math with escaped slashes like \\( instead of \(, or if it escaped the dollar signs like \$x^2\$, KaTeX will ignore it because it doesn't recognize the delimiters. You can verify this by right-clicking the explanation on your website, selecting "Inspect", and looking at the HTML text. If you see \$ or \\(, you will need to adjust your Quill editor settings on the backend to stop it from escaping those characters.
